rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard DFT-MD (PBE functional, CP2K) and well-known structural analysis (pair distribution functions, bond angle distributions, Voronoi tessellation). The main challenge is correctly building the amorphous initial configuration and choosing simulation parameters, which adds a minor variation beyond a textbook single-command operation. No novel algorithm or deep math translation is required.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has multiple stages: generating an amorphous structure, running CP2K at four temperatures with equilibration and production, extracting trajectories, computing partial PDFs, bond angle distributions, and performing Voronoi tessellation. This involves several sequential steps, handling CP2K inputs and output formats, and orchestrating the workflow across temperatures. It is more than a straightforward 2‑stage script but does not require a fragile multi-tool orchestration or a very long chain of dependencies.
